# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Python Software Foundation Code of Conduct](https://policies.python.org/python.org/code-of-conduct/). We expect everyone who takes part in this repository, in Transifex and in related discussions to follow it.

To report a violation, email the PSF Conduct Working Group at <conduct-wg@python.org>. You can also contact one of the coordinators listed in the [README](../README.en.md).
